label: At GO, fires after a rewarded S2 visit, weaker later in the episode.
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_common == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * belief_lo
explanation: Active only at GO. Magnitude is driven by the last trial having reached S2 and been rewarded (either choice; residual +0.16 vs -0.08 for every other pattern), which is evidence that S2 is good; it shrinks across the episode (on top of the GO timing decline) and is a bit higher when the trial before was also rewarded. Belief alone is a weaker graded correlate (low belief, S2 good, raises it). The free fit adds the largest bursts (~1.5): the S2 reward right after an S1-rewarded trial (a fresh switch of evidence toward S2), plus a small rare-transition bonus. The short form misses those bursts, so the dev score is 0.30 vs 0.38 for the free fit (ceiling all observed 0.38). No future variables used.
